name: Mafioso's Dice
detailed_description:
Mafioso’s Dice throws you into a deadly game as one of four mafia members seated around a tense table. Everyone knows the same truth: this table wasn’t set for friendship… Only one will survive—everyone else becomes a memory.

At the heart of the game lie dice rolls, risk management, and a high-stakes game of Russian roulette. Each player rolls dice to reach exactly 1230 points. But that’s just the beginning. The first player to reach the target points chooses an opponent, aims the gun, and pulls the trigger. If the bullet is in the chamber, the target is instantly eliminated. If not… the game goes on, and the tension builds.

There’s one bullet in a six-chamber revolver. Every click is a breath held.
Will luck, strategy, or bluffing get you to the end? You decide.

🔥 Key Features:

🎲 High-Stakes Dice Gameplay
Roll the dice to gather points, manage your risks, and hit the target of 1230 points. Once you do, the game shifts—now it’s not just about the dice, but courage and cunning.

🔫 Russian Roulette Mechanic
The player who reaches 1230 chooses a target and pulls the trigger. If the chamber holds a bullet, it’s game over for that player. But fate doesn’t always go as planned…

🃏 Fate Cards System
Each player holds a hidden Fate Card that activates only when the gun is aimed at them. These cards can offer a second chance, turn the tables, or force unexpected twists.

Some cards include:

  • Second Chance: Survive one more click!

  • Pickpocket: The shooter suddenly faces their own fate.

  • Forced Reroute: The shooter must pick a new target.

  • Blind Luck: The gun spins and aims at a random player.

🧠 Strategy, Bluffing & Mind Games
Fate Cards mean the game isn't just about dice and bullets. With hidden powers, bluffing, threatening, and building (or breaking) trust are key tactics at the table.

🕴️ Stylized Mafia-Themed Atmosphere
Dark, smoky, and retro—a noir mafia world brought to life. Eye contact, silent deals, and dramatic finales define the vibe.

👥 4-Player Online Co-op Thriller

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains stylized depictions of violence. Players engage in Russian roulette to eliminate each other, featuring dramatic gunshot sounds, a tense atmosphere, and elimination animations. There is no realistic blood or graphic violence.
The game does not include sexual content, drug use, or self-harm. Alcohol may be visually represented in the environment (e.g., bottles on the table) as part of the thematic setting. The game takes place in a dark, mature-themed mafia world.
